name: 技能广告预算
description: 审计系统提示里「技能广告」的成本：技能条数、估算 token 占比、最占位的条目，以及被重复广告（同 id）或近重复（不同 id、描述雷同）的技能。只读；可选按 id 去重，默认关闭。判定在 agent sidecar 内完成，只申请 agent.extension，不读文件、不联网、不起进程。

en.name: Skill Budget
en.description: Audits what the skill catalog costs inside the system prompt: how many skills are advertised, their estimated token share, the heaviest entries, and skills advertised twice (same id) or near-duplicated under different ids. Read-only, with optional same-id de-duplication that is off by default. Runs in the agent sidecar and declares only agent.extension: no file access, no network, no child processes.
en.safetyNotes: Declares exactly one permission: agent.extension, which is the capability that lets it read the system prompt at all. It never writes files, never touches the network, clipboard or credentials, never spawns processes and never calls a model. By default it only reports; rewriting the skill section requires an explicit dedupeSkillsSection setting and only ever removes an exact same-id duplicate, keeping the first occurrence. Token counts are labelled estimates because no tokenizer is exposed to plugins.

zh-CN.name: 技能广告预算
zh-CN.description: 审计系统提示里「技能广告」的成本：技能条数、估算 token 占比、最占位的条目，以及被重复广告（同 id）或近重复（不同 id、描述雷同）的技能。只读；可选按 id 去重，默认关闭。判定在 agent sidecar 内完成，只申请 agent.extension，不读文件、不联网、不起进程。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只声明一项权限：agent.extension，这本身就是它读取系统提示所需的能力。它不写文件、不碰网络/剪贴板/凭据、不起子进程、不调用任何模型。默认只报告；改写技能段需要显式开启 dedupeSkillsSection，且只删除「同一个 id 被广告两次」这种完全重复，保留第一次出现的那条。token 数是估算并已标注，因为宿主没有把分词器暴露给插件。

settings.title: 按 id 去重技能清单
settings.description: 开启后会把重复广告（同 id）的技能从系统提示里合并成一条。默认只审计不改写。
